text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just training... I don't want the other Umamusume
to see it. Me lookin' this clumsy, I mean.

To overcome her fear of the pack, she has to run with someone else.
Yet Tamamo Cross remained reluctant
to engage in serious tandem training.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I know nothin' will come of it unless we run together.
But showing any weakness means admitting defeat..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
They're gonna take advantage of me for sure. Mock me,
beat me down. That's just how the world is.
I hate it...

An unyielding Tamamo Cross. The thorn
embedded deep during her upbringing still hasn't come out.

Even so—there's a way. If that's the case,
all we need to do is gather Umamusume who won't exploit weaknesses...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tama-chan, I'm here to run alongside you~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Creek... Sorry.
Yeah, if it's you..."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Still~, Trainer. Tama-chan wants to train so she doesn't get intimidated by the pack, right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I can't manage it alone...
We'll need to flank it from both sides at least.

She was right. But there isn't another Umamusume
at Tracen Academy as warm and gentle as Super Creek.
No matter what... No matter what, just one more person...
—Would you mind if I joined in too?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Are you doing a tandem run?
I was just looking for a partner myself..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: O-Oguri...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Oguri-chan...
—Oguri Cap. An Umamusume with a hearty appetite who transferred from the Regional circuit to the Central circuit.

I've heard they're roommates and get along well,
but whether Tamamo Cross will actually
accept this or not is another question...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been running well in mock races lately either.
The other Umamusume keep pushing me wider and wider to the outside.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Even if I enter the Twinkle Series like this,
I don't think I can make any real impact..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I can't end this without bringing anything back home...
I don't want that.
I have to turn things around this summer, somehow...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri... you too...
Tamamo Cross stared intently at Oguri Cap—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri... I'll do it. Let's do this thing.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Let's do a tandem run!
The three of us—me, you, and Creek!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Will you let me join in?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Course it is. We've got things to do.
We can't be standin' around in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'll definitely find it!
A way to smash down this wall in front of me!"

And so—their three-person
matching training began.

text_block_list.name: Oguri & Creek
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaah!
Take thiiiis!
First, Oguri Cap and Super Creek take off running. Tamamo Cross watches Oguri Cap's stride intently.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...? What's with Oguri's form there?
Trainer, doesn't she look a bit low to the ground?
A low-center-of-gravity form, commonly seen in Umamusume destined for greatness. As expected, Oguri Cap possesses exceptional natural talent.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I've seen that running style somewhere before...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, a dog.
That huge dog at the park...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I play with the little kids in the park a lot.
Sometimes, when I do..."

text_block_list.name: Big Dog
text_block_list.text: Bow, bow-wow!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, is that some rich guy's dog~?
Cut it out, cut it out~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Big dogs try to play with me sometimes.
They crouch down and then BAM! Charge right into me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm always the one who gets shoved aside on impact.
Her form looks just like that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri's is only a little lower, but
if we push that to the extreme...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Fwooooo...!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...!? Tama-chan, what's with that outfit...

Tamamo Cross caught her breath and lowered her stance.
Her already small frame sank even lower—
choice_data_list: Tamamo Cross, try sprinting just like that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ready to roll, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I don't know. But it does seem worth trying.
I don't know. But it seems worth trying.

text_block_list.text:
It makes logical sense. Lowering your posture
reduces the risk of falling by that much.
If I can dive into the pack with this form—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Oguri! Creek!
From here on out, all three of us run together!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Doryaaaaaaahhhhhh!!!!!

The three fight fiercely neck and neck.
How will this running form play out in the end?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Take this, and this, and thaaaat!
Oho, now this is...!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I can do it! I really can! I don't feel like falling at all.
Even right beside me... my legs aren't shaking!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... Tama-chan...

The effect was undeniable. That Tamamo Cross
was running alongside without fear. However—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I won't let you pass, Tama!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ghk...! Getting matched stride-for-stride this long
is brutal... Gotta regroup!
She was forced to fall back. Running side-by-side for an extended period inevitably brought out her lingering, faint fear, and the disadvantage in build could not be overcome.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Just my form isn't enough... One more thing, just one more thing, I need something...!

Watching Tamamo Cross struggle, I pondered.
I felt like I was forgetting something important.

Overcoming the pack is important, but we don't
run just to overcome it. The ultimate goal is victory.
With a petite frame, there's no need to engage in a prolonged battle. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: !! "The White Lightning"...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... that's right...
My real weapon is... a flash of inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to run with the pack.
So long as I have the sharp turn of foot... to slice right through it!

Staying low, Tamamo Cross began to chase from a considerable distance back.
Like a bow being drawn taut.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Crouch low, build up power... and dash right through.
The match will be decided in an instant!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: This is the new "White Lightning"!!
(Caaawww!!)
After the race, everyone was lost for words. As if they had just witnessed the unbelievable.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Tama's running just now was...
choice_data_list: That's all thanks to your strong lower body.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Tama's running just now was...
choice_data_list: That's all thanks to your strong lower body.

text_block_list.text:
Maintaining that form throughout the run
is no ordinary feat.

The tenacity of Tamamo Cross's legs and hips
snatched victory from the jaws of defeat and opened up a whole new realm.
Even while struggling, Tamamo Cross tenaciously kept searching for a way forward.

It was because of your strong heart that you reached it.
A new running style that cuts through the pack with ease.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Oguri, Creek.
Thanks, Trainer. I've found it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: This run ain't just an escape route. It's a new path to get massively stronger. Burst right through to the front!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's gonna be intense training this summer. And then, I'll completely master this form.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I don't ever wanna stop again!
Trainer, I'm counting on ya."
The dark clouds following the accident finally cleared—and the 'White Lightning' was reborn.
"Thanks to her own grit and imagination... and a dream chaser who came from the countryside."
